### Setup & Run

```bash

npm install nodemailer

SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com SMTP_PORT=587 \
```

- Contains the full order summary: overview, financials, customer breakdown, top products, and key takeaways

You'll need to fill in your **SMTP credentials** — either directly in the script or via environment variables:

| Variable | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `SMTP_HOST` | Mail server hostname | `smtp.gmail.com` |
| `SMTP_PORT` | Mail server port | `587` (TLS) or `465` (SSL) |
| `SMTP_USER` | Login username | `you@gmail.com` |
| `SMTP_PASS` | Login password / app password | `abcd efgh ijkl mnop` |
